H1.metric: paired mean ON minus OFF exact accuracy

H2.metric: pooled exact accuracy at all n>=threshold, separately per mode; <=5% truncation in EVERY relevant cell required for PROVEN

H3.metric: mean measured thinking tokens at 5/3 and 10/5, both inequalities required; <=5% truncation in each cell required

H4.metric: paired program-minus-moves accuracy pooled equally across three levels and both modes

intervals: stratified paired percentile bootstrap for differences; independent bootstrap for token mean ratios; Wilson for near-zero endpoint and displayed accuracy boundaries; per-level accuracy bootstrap also saved
overall_rule: Three-regime pattern PROVEN only if H1,H2,H3 all PROVEN; DISPROVEN if any is DISPROVEN, otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. H4 is a separate representation claim. Incomplete confirmatory cells make affected hypotheses INCONCLUSIVE. Nominal separate 95% tests, no familywise claim.
